name: jlcpcb
label: JLCPCB
notes: Copper's default profile. Design rules: 'standard' sits slightly ABOVE JLCPCB's published minimums so boards stay in the no-surcharge tier; 'advanced' is close to the published limits. Checked against jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities on 2026-11-09: published minimums are track/space 0.10 mm (1-2 layer) and 0.09 mm (multilayer), via hole 0.15 mm (0.2 mm preferred) with 0.25 mm via diameter, copper to routed edge 0.2 mm, silkscreen text 1.0 mm high / 0.15 mm line, max drill 6.3 mm, NPTH min 0.5 mm, pad-hole to pad-hole 0.45 mm. Every number here is at or above those except min_text_height. UNVERIFIED (carried over from Copper's earlier preset, not re-confirmed against a JLCPCB page): the 0.3 mm 'no surcharge' via-drill threshold, the 100x100 mm cheap price tier, the 10x10 mm minimum for assembly, the $3 Extended feeder-loading fee, min_text_height 0.8 mm (JLCPCB publishes 1.0 mm; raise it if small text matters) and the JLC04161H-7628 stackup name. BOM/CPL column names follow JLCPCB's assembly upload template; the rotation table is the community cpl_rotations_db.
